reviewed_by: Codex independent callable protocol dispatch and source-family review 2026-10-25
review_notes: Restore generator-coroutine versus normal callable retry-engine dispatch in retry.wrap. Sync callables must keep value-return protocol through Retrying; native async uses AsyncRetrying; Tornado gen.coroutine wrappers must receive TornadoRetrying and yield awaitable completion. This is an independent production symbol/contract from BaseRetrying.wraps PR406 metadata/default propagation. All original28 F2P+95 P2P and six full files retained. Native source test assets are restored only from frozen upstream commit. No matcher/config/test/assertion changed, no model sampled.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,asyncio
import tenacity
from tenacity import retry,Retrying,AsyncRetrying,TornadoRetrying,stop_after_attempt
from tornado import gen
actual=Path(tenacity.__file__).resolve()
expected=(Path.cwd()/'tenacity/__init__.py').resolve()
print('source_binding',actual,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
@retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(1))
def sync_value(x):
 return x+1
@retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(1))
async def native_value(x):
 return x+2
@retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(1))
@gen.coroutine
def generator_value(x):
 raise gen.Return(x+3)
print('retry_engines',type(sync_value.retry).__name__,type(native_value.retry).__name__,type(generator_value.retry).__name__)
assert type(sync_value.retry) is Retrying
assert type(native_value.retry) is AsyncRetrying
assert type(generator_value.retry) is TornadoRetrying
assert sync_value(10)==11
async def observe():
 assert await native_value(10)==12
 assert await generator_value(10)==13
asyncio.run(observe())
print('sync_native_generator_protocols_passed')
PYREPLAY
